Subject: Capacity increase — PO path and vendor re-cert checklist

Hi Grace / Marissa,

Quick note from Procurement here — NimbleData is ready to sign for the additional capacity bundle we demoed last month. Before legal/finance will accept the PO we need two things: (1) a short vendor re-certification document confirming current SOC2 scope and data retention controls, and (2) a clear list of steps the finance team should follow in your purchase gateway so the PO can be processed without delay (billing contact, invoice cadence, billing address, any required SOW reference).

Can you confirm who at Redwood will own the re-cert and provide the portal checklist? We aim to have a signed PO by next Tuesday if possible.

Thanks,
Oliver Hayes
Procurement Manager

Oliver — attaching the SOW amendment and a one-page vendor attestation (SOC2 scope + retention summary). Also included a short onboarding checklist for your finance team that maps to our procurement portal fields. Highlights:

- Billing contact: Redwood Inference, Billing Ops <billing@redwood.com>
- Invoice cadence: Net 30, invoices issue on shipment date (see SOW section 3.2)
- Billing address: Redwood Inference, 1600 Mission St, San Francisco, CA 94103
- SOW reference: "SOW Amendment #2 — D-2026-0998" (please quote exactly on PO)
- Portal steps: 1) Create vendor record with our Redwood tax ID (listed in attestation), 2) Attach the signed SOW amendment, 3) Upload PO PDF and select "Capacity - Reserved" product line, 4) Route to billing@redwood.com for validation

I've attached: SOW_Amendment_v2.pdf, Vendor_Attestation_SOC2.pdf, Finance_Checklist_for_Nimble.pdf

If the PO needs a different invoicing cadence or a special remittance address for your AP system, let us know today and we can update the SOW. Otherwise Marcus will accept the PO and flag to billing once the signed document is in.

Marcus Lin
Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
